title: GPE — Eswatini Education System Capacity Grant, 2026
description:
"The Kingdom of Eswatini has secured a US$1 million (approximately E16.3 million) grant to strengthen its education system through a partnership between the Ministry of Education and Training, UNICEF and the Global Partnership for Education (GPE)."

"The Global Partnership for Education (GPE) System Capacity Grant Project (2026–2028) was officially launched on Friday, July 3, 2026... The grant, which will be implemented by the Ministry of Education and Training with UNICEF serving as the grant agent, is designed to strengthen the systems that support education delivery."

"The project will strengthen Education Management Information Systems (EMIS) to improve planning and resource allocation, expand teacher coaching and instructional leadership, support curriculum implementation, strengthen learning assessments and improve inclusive education so that all children, including learners with disabilities and those from disadvantaged communities, benefit from quality education."
recipient_organisation: Ministry of Education and Training, Eswatini
original_amount: US$1,000,000 (announced alongside E16.3 million as the local-currency equivalent, dated 2026-07-03)

title: Digital Eswatini Project
description: Increases access to affordable broadband internet and improves the government's capacity to deliver digital public services. Supports broadband infrastructure deployment, digital government platforms, and digital economy enabling environment in the Kingdom of Eswatini.

title: Jenny Internet — Eswatini Investment Promotion Authority (EITF Wi-Fi sponsorship), 2026
description: "Jenny Internet has strengthened its commitment to supporting digital connectivity and business growth in Eswatini through a E570 000 sponsorship for free Wi-Fi at the Eswatini International Trade Fair (EITF) 2026." "The partnership marks the third consecutive year that Jenny Internet has returned as the official Wi-Fi sponsor of the Trade Fair, with the company providing internet connectivity throughout the nine-day event at the Mavuso Trade and Exhibition Centre." EIPA CEO Sibane Mngomezulu said the sponsorship "demonstrated Jenny Internet's commitment to trade, business development and digital innovation in Eswatini."
recipient_organisation: Eswatini Investment Promotion Authority / Eswatini International Trade Fair

title: Construction of Disaster Recovery Site for National Data Centre (RSTP Phase 2)
description: Government of India Line of Credit to Eswatini for construction of a Disaster Recovery Site (DRS) for the national data centre as part of the Royal Science and Technology Park (RSTP) Phase 2. The LoC agreement was signed between India Exim Bank and the Government of Eswatini. The project builds a secondary data centre facility providing business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities for government IT systems and national data assets.

title: Eswatini IFMIS and PFM Capacity Building Project
description: Improves planning and control of public expenditures, investment management, and accountability in the Kingdom of Eswatini through deployment and expansion of an Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS). Supports IFMIS rollout to line ministries, budget execution systems, and internal audit capacity building.

title: World Bank — Eswatini Health System Strengthening (CBHIS), 2020
description: Project Appraisal Document (PAD3539, 29 May 2020) for the Health System Strengthening for Human Capital Development project in Eswatini. The US$20m project finances, among health-system components, the electronic Community-Based Health Information System (CBHIS).
